name: wallnumericentry-simple
description: IXT-SUITES: wallNumericEntry (pro) flag gate + a real interaction. Simple/Pro gate on the WallNumericEntry overlay presence while drawing a wall; a real length+Enter commit adds a wall of the exact typed length.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); })()

steps.name: assert-simple-hidden
steps.failMessage: wallNumericEntry should be OFF in Simple mode

steps.name: assert-pro-on
steps.failMessage: wallNumericEntry should be ON in Pro mode

steps.name: start-wall-draft
steps.eval: (() => { const svg = document.querySelector('.plan-paper'); if (!svg) throw new Error('plan-paper svg not found'); const r = svg.getBoundingClientRect(); window.__cx = r.left + r.width/2; window.__cy = r.top + r.height/2; const opt = { bubbles:true, cancelable:true, composed:true, pointerId:9, pointerType:'mouse', isPrimary:true, button:0, buttons:1, clientX:window.__cx, clientY:window.__cy }; svg.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', opt)); })()

steps.name: numeric-overlay-visible
steps.failMessage: WallNumericEntry overlay (Wall length input) did not mount after starting a wall draft in Pro mode

steps.name: wall-added
steps.failMessage: Committing the numeric-entry length did not add a wall

steps.name: assert-exact-length
steps.eval: (() => { const walls = window.__store.getState().floorPlan.walls; const w = walls[walls.length - 1]; const len = Math.hypot(w.end[0]-w.start[0], w.end[1]-w.start[1]); if (Math.abs(len - 3) > 0.02) throw new Error('expected the committed wall to be 3 m long, got ' + len); return len; })()
